title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — accountant organization-member context repair
purpose: Repair the proven authorization mismatch between the intended bookkeeper model (role=GUEST + job_profile=ACCOUNTANT/EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTANT) and the generic RLS/controller fences without globally widening GUEST. The slice adds a PostgreSQL-proven organization-member transaction primitive, migrates task-first accounting and Connection Center/attestation repositories to it, and admits GUEST only on the exact handlers whose durable capability checks are now proven.
boundaries: deriveTrustedRlsContext keeps rejecting GUEST; no global guest-role widening.
The organization-member transaction path requires authenticated user, session, tenant and organization and then proves ACTIVE membership with public.app_pc_crop_membership_id() inside PostgreSQL.

GUEST is admitted only on task-first accounting and Connection Center/attestation handlers; document generation, money, period close, reconciliation and other non-migrated handlers keep the class role fence.
Task reads require accounting.dashboard.read; manual task creation and transition remain controlled by accounting.task.manage / task policy, all resolved from durable job_profile/delegation.
Connection Center reads require integrations.read resolved from durable membership job_profile/delegation.
Attestation reads/writes retain integrations.read/integrations.configure and MFA checks already enforced by the repository.
No provider, 1C runtime, EDO runtime, Prisma schema, migration, hosting or production mutation.
No browser-selected capability/job profile becomes authority.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: Generic GUEST callers remain denied by withTrustedContext.
Organization-member context fails closed unless public.app_pc_crop_membership_id() returns an ACTIVE membership for current authenticated user/org.
GUEST + ACCOUNTANT gets daily accounting/task and connection reads but not one_c.configure, edo.configure, integrations.configure, period close or legal signing by role alone.
GUEST + EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTANT gets daily bookkeeping but not provider configuration, period close, reconciliation or signing authority by role alone.
Unprofiled GUEST gets baseline identity capabilities only and no task/connection data.
Cross-organization selection remains impossible because membership is resolved in PostgreSQL from current authenticated identity and organization.
